activity_statements.statement: delivers AI solutions to the federal government as the leading AI provider with 2,500+ AI specialists building secure, mission-specific systems for civil and defense agencies
provides cybersecurity services with 8,000+ cyber professionals delivering intelligence-grade solutions to defend national security and critical infrastructure assets
modernizes legacy government IT systems through digital transformation, designing cloud-enabled infrastructure, platforms and applications for federal agencies
delivers defense technology solutions for warfighters including rapid innovation programs that safeguard national security and maintain technological supremacy
develops space technology capabilities fusing AI, cyber and multi-modal data for domain awareness, ISR (intelligence, surveillance, reconnaissance) and battle management

name_reality_gap: Labeled Information Technology; historically Booz Allen was known as a management consulting firm, but the activity evidence shows it is now primarily a defense-and-intelligence technology integrator with 8,000+ cyber professionals and 2,500+ AI specialists — far more a tech contractor than a management consultancy.
extraction_notes: Two strong sources. Headcount figures for AI (2,500+) and cyber (8,000+) practices directly quoted. Quantum and space practices noted but smaller. Government client concentration well established.
